_meta.notes: DCC = full-swing LVCMOS output (DS: the code for VDD > 1.8 V). Pin 1 is typed nc to match the build (MPU OSC32_OUT left open); the DS also allows tying it to the host's X OUT — retype to 'reserved' if that is ever wired.

pins.name: NC
pins.note: No connect; ignores any signal. Float, or tie to the host's X OUT when replacing a crystal (Table 2)

pins.name: CLK Out
pins.note: 32.768 kHz LVCMOS (internal driver, load-independent). ±20 ppm at 25 °C post-reflow, ±100 ppm over -40..+85 °C

pins.name: Vdd
pins.note: 1.5-3.63 V over -40..+85 °C (Table 2); no bypass cap required (internal filtering). Abs max 3.63 V continuous
